key_findings: Microglial TRPV4 (not neuronal or endothelial) drives SNI-induced neuropathic pain, microglial activation/proliferation and excitatory spinal neuron plasticity.
LCN2 released from microglia is a key downstream mediator of TRPV4-dependent synaptic plasticity and pain.
